use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons for forms and dialogs
Destructive action buttons with confirmation workflows
Secondary/tertiary actions in toolbars and cards
ai_summary: A reusable atomic button component built with Radix UI Slot, class-variance-authority, and Tailwind CSS. Supports 6 variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and 4 sizes (default, sm, lg, icon). Includes accessible focus-visible ring states, disabled states, and asChild prop for composition with other Radix primitives. Forms the foundation of any interactive UI system.
